description: Get the expiry date of the SSL/TLS certificate of a host and the number of days left. No account and no API key are necessary.

api_key.description: Optional. A PingDeck API key (pd_live_...). Without a key the check uses the free pool: 100 checks a day for each IP address.

host.description: A host name, for example example.com. A port is optional: example.com:8443.

name: check_ssl
title: Check an SSL certificate
